definitions.gloss: condolence; mourning; grief for the deceased
definitions.explanation: Expressing sorrow and sympathy for someone who has passed away. A formal word used in official statements, funeral settings, and memorial contexts. Composed of 哀 (sorrow) + 悼 (mourn).

examples.japanese: ⟦{犠牲者|ぎせいしゃ}→犠牲者：18769_giseisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{哀悼|あいとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{念|ねん}→念：12766_nen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捧|ささ}げる→捧げる：02055_sasageru⟧。
examples.english: We offer our deepest condolences to the victims.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{声明|せいめい}→声明：03763_seimei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{亡|な}くなった→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧⟦{方々|かたがた}→方々：02778_katagata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{哀悼|あいとう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The prime minister mourned those who had died in a statement.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, dignified word used in official contexts such as funeral speeches, press statements, and memorial ceremonies. Not used in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {哀悼|あいとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意|い}→意：30489_i⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{表|ひょう}する (to express condolences)
- {哀悼|あいとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{念|ねん}→念：12766_nen⟧ (feelings of mourning)
- ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{哀悼|あいとう} (deep condolence)
- {哀悼|あいとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧ (words of condolence)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦お{悔|く}やみ→お悔やみ：15866_okuyami⟧ is the everyday word for offering condolences to someone. {哀悼|あいとう} is more formal and used in public, official contexts. ⟦{追悼|ついとう}→追悼：14312_tsuitou⟧ (commemoration) focuses on honoring and remembering the deceased, often in memorial events.
